# Abstract sources and transcription audit

Checked on 2026-10-31. Abstract text is copied from the linked source, not written or translated for this collection. Layout whitespace, PDF line-wrap hyphenation, and HTML entities are normalized; BibTeX special characters are escaped. Original wording, spelling and grammatical errors are retained. No `annote` fields remain.

The Telbisz TDK and MSc records were examples supplied with the original PR and are removed because they are unrelated to Refinery.

The two metadata reproductions explicitly identified below could not be compared with a publisher PDF. All other included abstracts were taken from author-maintained records, author PDFs, publisher pages, conference pages, the official TDK portal, or university repository records.

## Missing abstracts

- `semerathPhd2019`: the author PDF exceeds the available reader’s size limit; no separately published, complete thesis abstract was retrieved. Its abstract is omitted.
- `marussyPhd2023`: the author PDF’s front matter has no standalone abstract section, and the institutional repository was inaccessible. The thesis booklet is an extended document, not a short abstract; it has not been substituted for one. Its abstract is omitted.

The abstract of the 2026 junction-scenarios journal article is taken from the final Springer page rather than its differently worded arXiv preprint. The Acta Cybernetica HTML/author BibTeX abstract loses ligatures and inserts broken words, so the author-deposited PDF supplies that abstract.

All three retained TDK reports supply original English abstracts and English cover titles. Confirmed Hungarian reports are excluded. Five reports without public full text are omitted because no English portal abstract was found; their report language remains unverified. See [TDK_SOURCES.md](TDK_SOURCES.md) for the excluded records and evidence. Frey’s source spelling “bevaiours” and the TDK acronym “PTE”, and Baksa–Papp–Ruszka’s “Trainbecnhmark”, are retained as printed.
